Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient
Contains abstract payload definitions sent from the server to the client.

Serves as the base package for all network responses and state updates pushed by the server.
